criteria.criterion: ccmorph run -i, ccmorph config and ccmorph inspect on a closed or piped stdin (no tty) exit with a named cause ("needs a terminal") and a non-zero status; none waits forever, and run -i does not print Cancelled and then hang.
criteria.evidence: cli/ui.go (uiTheme.search, 631f726) asks /dev/tty itself before launching fzf: where a terminal answers, the picker runs untouched and unbounded; where none does, the caller's own picker command runs once under pickerNoTerminalBound (5 s, `_CCMORPH_PICKER_BOUND` seam) with captured streams, an answering fake still chooses, Esc (130) still cancels, and anything else is refused by name. Regression: `CCMORPH_TEST_FILTER=test_pickers_refuse_by_name_without_a_terminal_issue_725 zsh tests/ccmorph_test.zsh` -> PASS: test_pickers_refuse_by_name_without_a_terminal_issue_725, All 1 tests passed (run 2026-11-21 on this branch). The test drives run -i, config, inspect and inspect -i under </dev/null, detached into their own session so no controlling terminal exists, inside a 20 s bound, asserting each exits non-zero, prints `needs a terminal`, and prints no `Cancelled`. With cli/ui.go reverted to main's 356108e and the core rebuilt, the same command printed `ccmorph run -i with no terminal waited forever instead of refusing`, then the same line for config, inspect and inspect -i -> FAIL: test_pickers_refuse_by_name_without_a_terminal_issue_725, 1 of 1 tests failed. Go side: `go test ./cli/ -run TestSearchPickerWithoutTerminal -count=1` -> ok, with the fake fzf pinned first on PATH, its invocation marker asserted, and the exact refusal text and rc checked; the waiting-picker case is stopped by the bound seam in 200 ms.

criteria.criterion: One shared no-tty guard covers the pickers behind all three verbs (not one check per entry point).
criteria.evidence: The guard (ttyUsable + runPickerAnswerOnly + refuseNoTerminal) lives in uiTheme.search in cli/ui.go, the search picker every profile picker walks through: cli/menus.go:109 and cli/menus.go:189 call uiSelect("search", "Profile", ...), and cli/ui.go:223 dispatches uiSelect to t.search. `grep -rn 'exec.Command(fzf' --include=*.go . | grep -v _test.go` prints only `cli/ui.go:911: cmd := exec.Command(fzf, args...)`; `grep -rn fzf lib/ | wc -l` is 0, so the shell layer starts no picker of its own. The zsh regression exercises run -i, config, inspect and inspect -i through that one function.

criteria.criterion: A zsh-suite regression test runs each verb under </dev/null inside a timeout: it fails on today's main (hang) and passes after; interactive picker behaviour with a tty is unchanged.
criteria.evidence: Fails on main, passes after: see criterion 1's revert run (cli/ui.go at 356108e -> four `waited forever instead of refusing` lines, FAIL) and branch run (PASS). Interactive unchanged: the tty branch of uiTheme.search is the pre-issue launch untouched (`cmd.Stderr = os.Stderr; out, err = cmd.Output()`, no clock), entered whenever stdin is a tty or /dev/tty opens, so a foreground person's picker and piped stdin on a terminal behave as before; the existing picker tests all pass on the full gate (tests/ccmorph_test.zsh `All 84 tests passed`, including test_model_command_sets_the_profiles_default_model, test_set_model_interactively_saves_the_chosen_id, test_set_effort_interactively_offers_the_engine_levels, test_search_picker_on_an_old_fzf_never_hides_rows_silently_issue_278 and test_the_picker_without_fzf_names_the_direct_command_and_the_choices), and `go test ./...` is green. A pty-backed person-path test is not runnable in this sandbox (no ptys); that path is the unchanged pre-issue code. Gate on 631f726: launch 84 passed, install 361 passed, configure 85 passed, go vet and `go test ./...` green (one intermittent util/sharedbridge_test.go process-table case failed in 2 of 3 loaded runs and passed in the third; the util test binary is byte-identical under either cli/ui.go, sha256 9e6e6bfd96614a63d77c72f6f0e5e97842f6e3cc4410f1b194ee8847c988e020, and util does not import cli, `go list -deps ./util | grep -c ccmorph/cli` = 0). pytest 10 failed, 1402 passed: the same failures occur with cli/ui.go at 356108e — doctor_test.py + adapter_test.py run on the branch gave `10 failed, 132 passed, 1 skipped` and the reverted tree gave the identical set and counts (diff of sorted FAILED/SUBFAILED lines empty), all loopback/process-inspection limits of this sandbox.
